rules.name: combined-var-03-identity-uat
rules.sql: SELECT current_database() AS db_name, inet_server_port() AS port, current_user AS db_user, now() AS db_time, pg_postmaster_start_time() AS server_started

SELECT relname AS table_name, n_live_tup AS live_rows, n_tup_ins AS inserts_since_stats_reset, n_tup_upd AS updates, n_tup_del AS deletes, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND relname IN ('helper_var_accounting_report', 'helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'var_aggregation_level_table', 'cloned_product_master_table', 'var_cont_price_change_table', 'var_cont_vol_change_table') ORDER BY relname

WITH acct AS ( SELECT subportfolio FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu ), agg AS ( SELECT aggregation_level, subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) FROM agg) AS levels_as_in_pod_log, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct) AS acct_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE subportfolio IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM agg)) AS acct_rows_joined, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report) AS acct_rows_all_bu

expect.reason: the pod reads database operadb (pod log, jdbc url). A FAIL means postgres-uat is NOT the operadev database
the pod reads port 10505. A FAIL means another server (or a tunnel/proxy on another port: then use the statistics below)
the pod log shows levels=93 for cfs
the pod log shows pnlRows=0. A FAIL (rows above 0) means this database holds data the pod did not see
